events.title: Property Showing
events.note: Loved the open kitchen. Backyard smaller than we want.

events.title: Offer Submitted
events.note: Offer sent on 200 Example Pine Ct. Seller response expected within 48 hours.

events.title: Escrow Deposit Due
events.note: Wire or deliver your deposit to the title company. Always call title at a known number to confirm wiring instructions before sending.

events.title: Home Inspection
events.note: Plan for about 3 hours. You're welcome to come for the last 30 minutes walkthrough.

events.title: Appraisal
events.note: Your lender orders this. We'll post the date once it's scheduled.

events.title: Closing Day
events.note: Bring a government ID. Keys are yours once it records.
